create.description: Create a new organization with full information including representative details, tax code and email configuration. Requires `organization.create` permission.

list.description: Get list of organizations with pagination and search. Requires `organization.list` permission.

read.description: Get detailed information of an organization including representative and configuration. Requires `organization.read` permission.

delete.description: Soft delete an organization. Requires `organization.delete` permission.

delete_many.description: Soft delete multiple organizations at once. Requires `organization.delete` permission.

list.description: Get list of organization members with pagination.

invite.description: Send invitation to one or more users to join the organization.

cancel_invite.description: Cancel an invitation sent to a member.

accept.description: Accept invitation to join the organization.

reject.description: Reject invitation to join the organization.

remove.description: Remove member from organization. Cannot remove owner.

leave.description: Member leaves the organization. Owner cannot leave without transferring ownership.

assign_roles.description: Assign one or more roles to a member in the organization.

assign_permissions.description: Assign permissions directly to a member in the organization.

transfer.description: Transfer organization ownership to another member. Only current owner has permission.

create.description: Create a new role with assigned permissions. Requires `organization.list` permission.

list.description: Get list of all roles in the organization including permissions.

read.description: Get detailed information of a role including permission list.

update.description: Update role information including name, description and permissions.

delete.description: Soft delete a role. Roles in use cannot be deleted.

create.description: Create a new API key for the organization with permissions and rate limit configuration. Key is only displayed once after creation.

list.description: Get list of all API keys of the organization. Key value is not returned.

read.description: Get detailed information of an API key including permissions and configuration.

update.description: Update API key information including name, description, permissions and configuration.

reset.description: Regenerate API key value. Old key will no longer work. New key is only displayed once.

delete.description: Soft delete an API key. Key will no longer work.
